text:
I wrote `public/framework/ui/words/doc/architecture.md` (about 45 lines) and committed it in the worktree as `a6a016537`. I haven't loaded the page or run `merge.mjs`; it's a docs-only change.

- **Sources:** `ArchitectureCensus.mjs --decisions ui/words` returned no task-log decisions, so I wrote all six entries from `words.js` and its comments.
- **`⚠` code mismatches:** none; every entry matches the code.
- **Readme and `notes:`:** I added the `doc/architecture.md` link to the readme's `## More` list. `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so I left it alone.
- **Line endings:** git warned that `readme.md` will switch from CRLF to LF on this commit.

I wrote `public/framework/ext/DesignTool/doc/architecture.md` (75 lines, 11 entries) and committed it as 0746f61ab. I also added `architecture` to the `notes:` list in `page.js` and put the `doc/architecture.md` link on the readme's `## More` decisions line.

The brief's `ArchitectureCensus` command returned only off-topic decision lines, so the entries come from `doc/decisions.md` and the readme. I checked each against the code:
- **Code mismatches (`⚠`):** none found.
- **Checked in code:** vision's `Read,Glob,Grep` tool list, the `analyze()` comment saying it has no grade, polish's cap at medium, `probe()`'s `depth = 20` and `max = 4000`, and `frame()`'s 350ms wait.
- **Taken from `decisions.md` without re-reading the code:** the click-only `ask()` (I only saw the comment in `vision.js`), the 40-navigation browser recycle, and the uncapped audit rows.

`doc/files.jsonl` was already modified in the worktree before I started, and I left it out of the commit.

I wrote `public/framework/core/App/doc/architecture.md` (47 lines) and committed it in the worktree. It has seven decision entries.

I added it to the readme's `More` line and to the `notes:` list in `page.js`. I didn't run the site or any smoke test.

No code mismatches, so no `⚠` lines. I checked `App.js` against each entry. The census command (`ArchitectureCensus.mjs --decisions`) printed nothing, so the entries come from `doc/decisions.md` and the code. I couldn't find the `mode.js` reason in the code, so I took it from the readme's warning about the import that once took the site down.

`styles/sections` now has a `doc/architecture.md` (58 lines, 9 decisions), linked from the readme's "More" section and committed as 4912c92b7. I didn't run `merge.mjs` or the page smoke test.

- **Brief:** the path you gave (`.../architecture-md-2/minion-brief.md`) doesn't exist. I worked from `architecture-md-2/requirements.md` and the batch-1 `architecture-md/minion-brief.md` instead. I did not append anything to `task.jsonl`.
- **Code mismatch:** `doc/decisions.md` §3 and the page text say the dark tone uses `--ink` and inverts in dark mode. The code (`tone.js`) uses `--bg`, which stays dark in both modes. I flagged this with a ⚠ under that entry and left `decisions.md` and the page text unchanged.
- **Page notes:** `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so there was nothing to add there.

Files are in `public/framework/styles/sections`:
- `doc/architecture.md`
- `readme.md`

I wrote `public/framework/ui/card/doc/architecture.md` (33 lines) and committed it as 89257ab05.
- **Checks:** I checked the entries against `framework.css` and `page.js`, and none disagreed with the code, so there are no `⚠` mismatches.
- **Readme:** I added the `doc/architecture.md` line to the readme's `## More`. `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so I left it alone.
- **Decision log:** `ArchitectureCensus.mjs --decisions ui/card` returned no log lines, so the entries come from the readme and the code.

I wrote `public/framework/core/Shell/doc/architecture.md`, 58 lines, and committed it in the worktree. It has nine decision entries.
I added it to the readme's `## More` line and added `architecture` to the `notes:` list in `page.js`. `node --check` passes on `page.js`; I didn't load the page.
One mismatch is flagged with a ⚠ in the doc: `doc/decisions.md` says the saved width goes through `Page.Store`, but `Shell.js` calls `new Page.Prefs({ id: "shell:" + name })`.

The new `ext/filesystem` architecture doc is written and committed in the worktree as `bcb58a4a9`.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/filesystem/doc/architecture.md`, 59 lines. It has 8 decision entries. I also added it to the readme's `## More` line and to the `notes:` string in `page.js` (now `"architecture decisions"`).
- **`⚠` code mismatches:** none. Every entry matches `FsFile.js`, `tree.js` and `Dir.js`.
- **Stray changes:** the working tree has many unrelated `files.jsonl` modifications that I did not stage. I did not run `node --check` on `page.js`.

I wrote `public/framework/ux/Content/doc/architecture.md` (about 56 lines, 7 decisions) and linked it from the readme's `## More` line. It's committed in the worktree as `5bef82c17`, and I didn't run the smoke test or merge.

- **Code mismatch (⚠):** the old decision log says `ext/AITask/decisions.js` imports `Decision`. That file no longer exists. `ext/Chat` and `ext/Collab` import it today, so the entry says that and carries a `⚠` line.
- **`page.js`:** it has no `notes:` list, so I left it alone.

I wrote `public/framework/ext/files/doc/architecture.md` (51 lines) and committed it in the worktree as 8342d6772. The commit also adds `doc/architecture.md` to the readme's `## More` list and `architecture` to the `notes:` string in `page.js`.

I checked the entries against `files.js` and `Page.class.js` and found no `⚠` mismatches. `Page.class.js` does load `explorer.js` or `fs.js` for the `/fs/` route, and `files.js` does the `open` depth, `lines` and `grip` handling.

I skipped one check: whether the `doc/decisions.md` link for the line-marks entry (`#L42` scrolling) matches what that doc says.

I wrote `public/framework/ui/stats/doc/architecture.md` (30 lines) and committed it with the readme change as `703dc20af`.
- The readme now has a `## More` line linking it. There was no `notes:` list in `page.js`, so I left that file alone.
- There were no `⚠` code mismatches. The decisions census returned nothing for `ui/stats`, so I wrote the four entries from the code in `page.js`.
- I didn't open a task or run `merge.mjs` (the brief didn't ask for either), so the commit is on the worktree branch only.

I wrote `public/framework/ext/Research/doc/architecture.md` and committed it as `81e03fdfd`. It's 82 lines, two over the 80 target, because I kept 13 entries. I added it to the readme's `More` line and to the `notes:` list in `page.js`.

One `⚠` mismatch: the schema marks `agent` as orchestrator-only, but minions update their own chip and the code doesn't enforce it.

I also didn't find MCP tools for program entries in the plugin, only the `entry.mjs` CLI. So the "Two writers, one core" entry says program entries have no MCP writer yet.

I wrote `public/framework/ext/Panel/doc/architecture.md` (47 lines) and committed it as `632545cf5` in the worktree. I didn't run `node Server/merge.mjs`, so it hasn't merged.

- **Links:** I linked the doc from the readme's `## Doc topics` list, because the readme has no `## More` line. I added `architecture` to `notes:` in `page.js`. The `page.js` edit passed `node --check`.
- **⚠ Mismatch:** `toolbar.js` (63 lines) is still in the module and nothing imports it, though `doc/decisions.md` says it was deleted. The architecture doc says so under the rail entry.
- **Brief location:** the brief wasn't in the worktree, so I read it from the main tree.
